contentText:
Andrew R. Chow / Time :

An interview with John Ternus, who says the memory shortage is “a crisis” and “all options should be on the table”, and that Tim Cook “has great relationships”   —  Andrew R. Chow/Cupertino, Calif. … Just below the broad smile he's been wearing all morning, John Ternus' hands are shaking.
